layout: Each X-axis transmission separates a Hand Crank from two Mechanical Presses. The crank can drive one press, while the load of two overloads it.
actions: Start the crank on GameTest tick 2. Change redstone on ticks 4 and 7. Phase 0 samples before actions and phase 1 immediately after the relevant action. Java records theoretical RPM and effective RPM through the gate and first press.
